payout_quote: You may participate either in-person in our lab or online on your home computer. Studies typically include cash or gift card payments averaging $25 an hour. None of our studies involves physical exertion or medical procedures.
steps: Register for the Stanford GSB Behavioral Lab participant pool (Sona Systems for stanford.edu members; National Participant Pool for others)
View available studies and their compensation amounts before signing up
Complete the pre-screen form for eligible studies
Attend in-person or complete online organizational/marketing studies; paid in cash or gift cards
catches: 'Averaging $25 an hour' - actual pay varies by study; check the posted compensation before signing up
18+; one Sona account per person; cannot repeat the same study
Graduate students in psychology, organizational behavior, or marketing are excluded
In-person studies are at Stanford GSB (California); others can only access the online pool
Study slots are irregular - not steady work
biggest_catch: Pay 'averages' $25/hour but varies by study - and in-person sessions require being at Stanford.
eligibility: 18+; registered participant; prescreened per study; psychology/OB/marketing grad students excluded
timing: Cash or gift card payment per study; compensation amounts shown before signup.
